translations.web: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
translations.bsb: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
translations.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
